### Putting on a Show
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-may-7-2024.html
Passage: Acts 5:4
Points:
- Ananias and Sapphira chose to present themselves as far more generous and spiritually devoted than they truly were.
- Their fatal judgment occurred not because they kept back money, but because they lied directly to the Holy Spirit.
- People often wish for apostolic-era miracles without realizing the severe holiness and accountability that accompanied them.
- Hypocrisy in the church mirrors Judas, whose outward gestures masked inward betrayal.
- Human performance may deceive onlookers, but God sees every hidden motive and cannot be fooled.

### Seek to Speak the Truth to Each Other
Author: Lynette Kittle
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-bible-verse/seek-to-speak-the-truth-to-each-other-bible-study-minute-october-16-2018.html
Passage: Acts 5:4
Points:
- People routinely justify bending the truth to protect feelings, manage reputations, or preserve peace.
- Deliberately holding back information to create a false impression is a form of defrauding others.
- The story of Ananias and Sapphira reveals that misrepresenting the truth to people is ultimately lying to God.
- Contemporary culture easily normalizes dishonesty, but Scripture strictly calls believers to speak the truth.
- Christians must examine their hearts, confess any deceit to God, and commit to complete honesty.
